en.hubeali: Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Ibn Abu Yafour who said,
‘Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘The one who publicises upon usasws of ourasws Ahadeeth, Allahazwj will Confiscate his Emān’.
en.sarwar: 3. Yunus has narrated from ibn Muskan from ibn abu Ya’fur who has said the following:
“Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘Whoever publicizes our (confidential) Hadith, Allah will take away his belief.’”
